correctness.rationale: Explicit payoff differences yield exact lumped birth–death transition probabilities, with a doubled inward probability only at the threshold edge. The actual included checker verifies 13,814 independent exact-rational identities and a 20-player benchmark, not the asymptotic theorem.

value.rationale: Quantifies the otherwise deceptively persistent mixed regime of alternating opposed coordination games: a complete finite-population mean lifetime and sharp exponential growth constant across a natural conflict parameter. It gives a reproducible benchmark for the mismatch of finite eventual consensus and long observed coexistence, without requiring a new general mathematical technique.
